roles.background: variations of Hodge structure, infinitesimal period maps, Hodge loci
roles.delegated_check: Check what a first-order deformation of the fixed witness implies about the base Hodge direction.
roles.finding: If the coefficient-preserving witness deforms with cohomology class equal to the flat α, its base direction keeps α of type (p,p), so the differential image of the witness-incidence projection is contained in the tangent space of the relevant Hodge locus/branch at the exact source scope.
roles.objection: At singular crossings, a witness deformation may land in the union Hodge locus without canonically selecting the same irreducible branch T; branch binding must be explicit.
roles.recommendation: Use only a branch-bound inclusion and do not infer local equality from tangent equality.

roles.background: Hilbert and Chow spaces, flag Hilbert schemes, deformation of subschemes and signed rational cycles
roles.delegated_check: Check the first-order lifting interface for the chosen finite signed witness.
roles.finding: For the standard incidence deformation problem, first-order liftable base directions are the image of dπ. If δ1 is defined as the corresponding connecting/obstruction map, its kernel is precisely that first-order image at the registered interface.
roles.objection: For rational signed cycles W_α is local coefficient-preserving bookkeeping across several component spaces, not a universal fine moduli space.
roles.recommendation: Scope any ker(δ1)=im(dπ) statement to the exact chosen witness incidence and obstruction sequence.

roles.background: normal-sheaf obstruction theory, semiregularity, derived deformation theory
roles.delegated_check: Determine whether direct δ1-vanishing is a weaker mechanism than geometric first-order liftability.
roles.finding: Once δ1 is the standard first-order obstruction map, δ1(v)=0 means exactly that v is first-order liftable in that deformation problem. Thus asking δ1 to vanish on all Hodge-branch directions risks restating tangent surjectivity rather than explaining it.
roles.objection: A different reduced obstruction object could change the representation, but then it is a fresh atom with a new compatibility theorem.
roles.recommendation: Run a representation-equivalence falsifier before further theorem invention.

roles.background: degenerations, specialization, monodromy, limiting Hodge theory and algebraization boundaries
roles.delegated_check: Audit whether a first-order tangent result advances higher-order/global obligations.
roles.finding: It does not: singular degeneration, higher Artin obstructions, algebraization, monodromy/component switching and global continuation remain independent.
roles.objection: Tangent equality at a smooth central fiber can be destroyed by higher-order nilpotents or singular boundary behavior.
roles.recommendation: Do not open degeneration arguments until a non-tautological first-order geometric mechanism exists, unless they provide an independent route.

roles.background: proof auditing, deformation-functor exactness, scheme-theoretic tangent pathologies
roles.delegated_check: Try to falsify the proposed equivalence before source expansion.
roles.finding: The equivalence survives only if δ1 is exactly the obstruction map whose zero set is the first-order liftable directions and if the Hodge branch is correctly bound. The main hostile cases are arbitrary obstruction maps, scheme-theoretic image versus differential image, branch crossings, and nonreduced structure.
roles.objection: Writing T_s0T=im(dπ) without these guards would overstate the source.
roles.recommendation: Predeclare a scoped theorem: δ1|T=0 iff T⊂kerδ1=im(dπ); add reverse inclusion only when coefficient-preserving witness deformation is branch-bound.

roles.background: mathematical novelty control, research-method metrology and evidence governance
roles.delegated_check: Classify possible value if the equivalence is verified.
roles.finding: The linear equivalence itself is elementary and likely RAKL_TRIVIAL; value would be route normalization—showing H4d1b has not reduced the first-order variational lifting difficulty.
roles.objection: Do not count a new file/commit as learning or promote a new method/tool from one episode.
roles.recommendation: If verified, record route-pruning, a candidate representation lesson, and reopen the search for an independently computable tangent-equality mechanism.

consensus: Run the exact first-order representation audit before any new criterion. Preserve branch, category, rational-coefficient, higher-order and globalization boundaries.
unresolved_disagreement: Whether an alternative reduced obstruction object could produce a genuinely weaker computable criterion is left open; it is outside H4d1b and requires fresh context.
